item.subject: science
item.stem: Rohan's grandfather in Lucknow has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. His doctor explains that this non-communicable disease cannot be cured in a few days, but it can be controlled. Which approach will best control his condition?

options.A: Taking one full course of medicine so that no further care is needed
options.B: Reducing physical activity so that the risk of heart disease also falls
options.C: Keeping him away from other family members for a few days
options.D: Managing the condition with regular medicine, a balanced diet, exercise and continuous checkups
